instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Orbit is a micro-scale real estate developer focused intensely on high-density urban residential projects. They currently manage a pipeline of 350 units across four active sites, emphasizing speed and efficiency through modular construction methods and detailed BIM-based cost estimation to mitigate rising material costs. The operational structure is highly agile, with developers balancing core project management tasks alongside exploratory technical analysis.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is formally embedded via quarterly hackathons and a maintained patent portfolio covering proprietary structural designs. A rotating 'innovation fellow' program allows high-potential staff dedicated time for exploratory projects; recently, this led to a production prototype of automated quality inspection using computer vision that successfully reduced defect escape rates by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: Orbit operates primarily within congested urban cores where land scarcity is extreme, making efficiency paramount to survival. They are keenly aware of shifting renter demographics demanding unique living experiences that go beyond standard floor plans.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Modular Niche Deployment
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging current BIM and computer vision successes to rapidly deploy 'micro-modular' units in underserved urban micro-locations where traditional construction is too slow. This addresses the primary pain point of project timelines.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on local zoning for alternative building methods.
Allocate 5% of R&D time specifically to modular component optimization.
resources_needed: Contract specialized structural engineering consultant (budget allocation: $8k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in construction cycle from 14 weeks to 9 weeks for 3 pilot units.
milestones: Q1: Finalize modular component design specifications and testing budget.
Q2: Launch pilot project with one unit using new methods.

opportunities.title: PropTech Adjacent Service Diversification: Urban Experience Platform
opportunities.rationale: Given the 'diversification' priority, this radical move involves moving beyond vertical development into creating a platform that manages fractional ownership, dynamic community services (e.g., on-demand amenities), and specialized short-term leasing for urban dwellers.

first_actions: Identify three adjacent local service providers in the city.
Develop an MVP API integration for property management features.
resources_needed: Hire a fractional tech consultant (budget allocation: $10k)
Allocate dedicated time from two generalist developers ($4k operational cost)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5 paying service contracts for property management/leasing services within Year 2.
milestones: Q3: Platform MVP launch and initial user acquisition strategy defined.
Q4: Secure first B2B partnership agreement.

next_steps.action: Formalize a 'Talent Scouting' sub-program focused on adjacent skills (e.g., data science, urban planning) to mitigate the talent barrier.
Establish a cross-functional steering committee dedicated solely to 'Diversification' opportunities and adjacent market research.

key_weaknesses: Lack of a dedicated, full-time innovation/R&D role resulting in purely opportunistic project timing.
Reliance on 'owner_alone' decision-making which can slow down radical strategic pivots needed for diversification.
High dependency on generalist developers whose capacity is overwhelmed by operational maintenance tasks.
